answer: The umber register is checked at draw time, mirror lists the eligible set, and zenith seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 57 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 57 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an farming party pays for every seat it wants. Verification alone takes 8 days each. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
